hero_subhead: Interior refresh or exterior makeover in Southampton? We deliver flawless finishes on time and on budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From interior redecorating to exterior restoration, we handle every job with care and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Redecorating
services.desc: Refresh your living spaces with expert interior painting. We prepare walls properly, use quality finishes, and protect your furniture and floors throughout.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Protection
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior work keeps your Southampton home looking smart and protected. We sand, prime, and paint woodwork and render to last years.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging for feature walls, full room coverage, or bespoke designs. We measure accurately and leave neat, lasting results.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, window frames, and built-in cupboards — we prime and finish all woodwork to a professional standard with smooth, durable coatings.

services.title: Ceiling & Plasterwork Painting
services.desc: Ceilings need specialist care. We use the right techniques and equipment to paint ceilings evenly without drips, and touch up plasterwork seamlessly.

services.title: Pre-Decoration Preparation
services.desc: Poor prep ruins good paint. We fill cracks, sand surfaces, and prime appropriately so your new finish looks professional and lasts longer.

about_pullquote: We prep properly and cut no corners—your home deserves a finish that lasts.
about_para_1: APG Painting and Decorating has been transforming homes across Southampton for over 15 years. We started because we saw too many decorators cutting corners on prep work. Our founder understood that a brilliant finish begins long before the brush touches the wall—it starts with proper surface preparation, quality materials, and genuine care for the homeowner's investment.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on reliability, honesty, and results. Our customers return to us because we turn up on time, protect their homes, and deliver finishes that keep looking fresh year after year. Whether it's a single room refresh or a full house project, we bring the same attention to detail and professional standards to every job.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About APG

reviews.text: Brilliant work from start to finish. Mark and his team came in, prepped everything properly, and painted the whole downstairs in three days. The finish is immaculate and they left the place spotless. Can't fault them. Already booked them for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with the previous decorator not showing up. APG came recommended and they were a total breath of fresh air. Friendly, professional, on time every single day, and the quality of the work is top notch. Our exterior now looks brand new.
reviews.author: Helen R.

reviews.text: Just had our kitchen and hallway done. The prep work was meticulous—they filled every crack and sanded properly. Two weeks in and the finish still looks perfect. Worth every penny. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James M.
